item.title: Jacob Skarby - Auslander Reiten theorem
item.description: Abstract Talk We recall the Auslander-Reiten quiver. Definition The Auslander-Reiten-quiver \Gamma_A for a given Algebra A has as vertices the representatives of indecomposable modules (called ind A) in modA.

item.title: Jose Pedro Qintanilha - Geometric invariants for locally compact groups
item.description: Abstract Talk Is there any connection we can make to MCGs? Can we link the invariants to different invariants (of MCGs?) We are interested in \Sigma-invariants, BNSR invaraints, ...
